December 5, 2024

# PrivateMetafield is now deprecated

DateDecember 5, 2024

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

Flags[Deprecation announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=deprecation-announcement)[Action required](https://shopify.dev/changelog?action_required=true)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)[Events & webhooks](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=webhook)

Starting in API version **2025-01**, PrivateMetafield will be removed from the GraphQL Admin API. Use [app-data metafields](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/metafields/use-app-data-metafields) instead. If the metafield is needed per resource, consider the [migration guide](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/custom-data/metafields/migrate-private-metafields) for using app-reserved namespaces.
